title: The Architecture of Failure: A Disclosure, with Logs
description:
By Jonathan A. Price. Published 2 November 2026. A disclosure, not a paper: a 166,037-word record — a poem, a forensic reading of what commercial language models do to a mind under sustained load, five verbatim session logs (four of them with Google's models), and the working charter built in answer — put in the open with SHA-256 hashes and Bitcoin-anchored OpenTimestamps proofs so that every claim can be checked against the record.

Four parts, in the order evidence arrives: The Yaowarat Partita (3,709 words); The Architecture of Failure, the main text (23,287 words); the Five Log Addenda (124,855 words); the Project Charter (14,186 words).

This deposit is the GitHub repository jonprice0/architecture-of-failure as released. The same record is published as a Hugging Face dataset under DOI 10.57967/hf/11368. Reading page: https://jonprice0.github.io/architecture-of-failure/

Not to be confused with Douglas Murphy's 2012 book The Architecture of Failure (Zero Books). The author is Jonathan A. Price, a writer; not the actor Jonathan Pryce.
